==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Was known in Brazilian solo queue as a full-on rager, even being called out on that by [[YoDa (Felipe Noronha)|YoDa]] during a [[CBLOL/2017 Season/Split 1 Promotion|CBLOL Promotion]] game day.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lj3PHlwqirI YoDa and Brucer trash talking Absolut (Portuguese/Video)] ''youtube.com''</ref> Months later, during an interview with caster [[Melao13]], [[Dioud]] stated that '''Absolut''' was getting a better mindset, focusing more on his game and synergy with his teammates.
* A '''"Pro vs. Pro"''' trashtalk session on [[Brazilian Challenger Circuit/2017 Season/Split 1 Playoffs|Challenger Circuit Finals]] with him and [[Ceos]] resulted in fans nicknaming him '''"Skull Crusher"'''.<ref>[https://clips.twitch.tv/TameWealthyYakDatBoi Pro vs Pro - INTZ Genesis vs T Show - Circuito Desafiante (Portuguese/Video)] ''clips.twitch.tv''</ref>
* Used to often play duo with [[Bulecha]], who he nicknamed '''"Bulinhas"''' due to their age difference. <ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OPO7KTkoX94 ABSOLUT e BULECHA ENTENDENDO O SMOLDER (BONECO NOVO) (Portuguese)] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Became a fulltime LoL streamer in Brazil after retiring. He is often referred as "Vovô" (Grandfather) by his fanbase due to looking a lot older than he actually is.<ref>[https://youtu.be/PvMPPIU7WJE JUKES DEU COACH PRO VOVÔ ABSOLUT! ELE VIROU UM PLAYER MELHOR? ESSE CONTEÚDO FOI PREMIUM DEMAIS (Portuguese)] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* His '''Kings Lendas''' team name comes from a pun with [[Los Grandes]] and his nickname "Vovô" (often reduced just to "Vô" just as Grandfather and Granpa in English).
